messages.content: Who won the chess tournament in 2015?

function.name: game_board_analyser
function.description: Analyse a given board position of the game and suggest the optimal next move Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the game. In this case, chess

player.description: The current player whose turn is to move.

position.description: The current state of the board in FEN (Forsyth–Edwards Notation) format.

difficulty.description: The level of difficulty for the suggested move. Options include 'easy', 'medium', 'hard'.

message.content:
I’m not sure which event you’re referring to—there were several high‑profile chess competitions in 2015:

| Event | Winner |
|-------|--------|
| **World Chess Championship** (Carlsen vs Karjakin) | Magnus Carlsen |
| **Candidates Tournament** (to determine challenger for the world title) | Levon Aronian (tied with others but finished first on tiebreaks) |
| **FIDE Grand Prix Series** (overall standings) | Vladimir Kramnik |
| **Chess Olympiad** (team competition) | Russia |

If none of those match what you had in mind, let me know which tournament you’re interested in!
message.reasoning:
The user asks: Who won the chess tournament in 2015? This question ambiguous; which tournament? Could refer to World Chess Championship 2015? That was held between Magnus Carlsen vs Sergey Karjakin, winner Carlsen retained title. Or could refer to some other major tournaments like Candidates Tournament 2015 or maybe something else.

We need clarification. According to policy, we should ask clarifying questions if ambiguous. So respond asking which specific tournament they mean. Also mention possible known winners. But better to clarify.
